reviews.text:
The best! Always helpful and they take the time to explain everything.
I've been a customer for two years. Both the grooming salon and the veterinary clinic. Highly recommended!!
Good morning Marc. Thank you very much for such a good rating! Greetings and we hope to see you soon!!
He is not my usual vet but they took care of our Míchael perfectly the same day. It is true that the store could be better laid out but that is another matter.
Hi Yesenia! Thank you so much for this high rating. Best regards, and see you next time!

A shop with everything you could possibly need, and even more so, it's a pleasure to receive advice from someone with so much experience and sensitivity towards animals.
My dogs and cats are so grateful.
I recommend it 100%.
Thank you so much!
Good morning Ignasi! Thank you very much for your rating. A hug and see you in December!!
Everything has been perfect since I met them. Pedro treats the animals with incredible calm, and Cris offers advice on everything she can and more. For me, it's a top-notch veterinary clinic.
I'm so happy to have found this shop. They treat me so well. They get everything I want for my cats. I wish there were more shops like this. Thank you for your help always.
Very friendly treatment and they are very kind.

Today I want to express my gratitude for the exceptional service I received and for all the help I got in fulfilling my need. I was looking for a coat and a harness for my dog, and the advice I received was truly outstanding.

We need more people like this—professional, knowledgeable, eager to work, and above all, willing to help others.

Thank you so much once again for the wonderful service. I know you're always there for me if I need anything.

Of course, after completing the purchase, you gave me a receipt in case anything goes wrong.

Thank you!
